title: Unit Event — On the Stage of Dazzling Light

meta.Event: On the Stage of Dazzling Light
meta.Outline: Ever since his visit to Riley Dream Park, Tsukasa has felt a desire to improve even more as an actor. In the troupe's new ambassadorial show, he takes on a character unlike any he has before, with a personality entirely opposite his own.

rows.Line: (If I'm going to have any hope of becoming a world-famous star, I'll have to find a way to raise my acting ability to at least their level...)

Alright, once more!
Reset my phone and...

No! All wrong!
My delivery sounds so unrefined and lacks any kind of depth. How can I match what I saw that time?

rows.Line: Hmmmm... Alright, again!

rows.Line: “Why do we have to fight each other?!”

Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Now that we're all here, I'll start explaining more about your next show assignment as ambassadors.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Question!
Where are we going next♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: These discussions feel really commonplace now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's exciting to hear from them since we always get to go somewhere new with each show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, where's our next destination...?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: The Special Stage at Central City Park...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The Special Stage at Central City Park?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know that place! It's the really, really big stage at the really, really big park, right?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. It's also a place where world-famous stars performed when they were just starting out...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we, at long last, get to perform there...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Well, that was the original plan...
Unfortunately, it has to undergo renovations starting next week to mend any age-related wear and tear.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: As a result, you'll be performing in the music hall located just near the Special Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: B-B-But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Why do you sound so disappointed?
That music hall's pretty big on top of being really nice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know... But my expectations skyrocketed just now and... Guh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
The music hall, eh...?
We have been performing outside for so long that this could be a nice change to try some new things.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I agree. They even said you can borrow any of their props as long as you ask in advance.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Here's their inventory list.
If anything catches your eye, I say ask and see what they think.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Ah, they've made some of their instruments available to us...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we know where we'll be performing and what we can use, let's start thinking about what we're gonna do.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!!
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's start discussing what we'll be doing for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A show at a music hall sounds like fun! Why not work some songs into your performance?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Some songs...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna play the tambourine!
And I also wanna shake-shake-shake the maracas!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rather predictable choices...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll play the castanets!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll play the recorder!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like your troupe's turning into a band.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can only sort of play the instruments I learned at school...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Same. The most I've really done is build some electric instruments for a show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What? That's incredible...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Tsukasa, can't you play the piano?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I can.
My mom's a piano teacher and I've been learning from her since I was little.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Your mom's a piano teacher!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I've even performed in some minor contests based on her suggestion!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But that's been on the sidelines ever since I decided to become a star... Although, I did use to practice quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I had no idea... I take it you can play pretty well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...
Why don't we do “A Pianist Named Thorpe”?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A pianist named... Wait, I've heard of that before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's a very famous novella.
It's even been turned into an audio play, so there's a script already available. However...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: However...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa may have a hard time playing the role of Thorpe.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? What do you mean?
He can play the piano. Doesn't that make him the perfect candidate?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
True...
Why don't we give it a quick try since we're on the topic?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, can we join you?!
Please, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'll have a hard time... Why?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What did he mean by that...?)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “A long time ago, in a certain town, there was a pianist named Thorpe.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Thorpe was a gifted pianist who lived on the outskirts of his town, and you could always hear the melodious sounds of a piano emanating from his place of lodging.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
Tsukasa's so good at playing the piano!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, he is!
I'd heard that he could play, but not this well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Rui! Rui!
Doesn't this make Tsukasa a perfect fit for Thorpe?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
He certainly won't have any problems when it comes to playing the piano...

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “But Thorpe had a rather grave failing. Whenever he tried to perform in front of others, he wasn't able to play to the best of his abilities...”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Thorpe would audition for his town's band many times, but fail every time due to not being able to perform when it matters most.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Having nowhere else to go, Thorpe began playing the piano at a local tavern that was so run down that it hardly ever received any visitors. A place where no one would hear him play.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
If only I could join a big band and play music with them...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “I know. In times like this, it's always nice to look at the stars...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “They're so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Thorpe looks up towards the stars because he feels stuck in terms of achieving his goals... He seems to have trouble facing reality because he lacks initiative...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
(I see...
So this is what Rui was worried about.)

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “As Thorpe sits and stares at the distant stars...”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line:
“Well, if it isn't Thorpe.
Is this where you're playing your piano these days?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Wait, you're the leader of that band...! It's been so long. What are you doing in a place like this?”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “Some of the band and I are here to have some drinks... I see that your love for playing the piano hasn't faded.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“No, it hasn't...
But I'm still not able to perform when it really counts...”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “You'd be more than welcome to play in my band if only you managed to overcome that... Oh, I know!”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “A big contest is going to be taking place in town soon. Why don't you enter into it?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “Wouldn't playing in front of a big crowd like that give you a big boost of courage? If you manage to win, my band may be willing to welcome you in as a new member.”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “Anyway, we'll be looking forward to your performance.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “If I win... I'll get to join them...?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “I'm probably never going to get another chance to join a band like this again... I have to enter!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Thorpe began practicing like there was no tomorrow.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “However, no matter how much he practiced, Thorpe still couldn't play well even during his mock rehearsal in front of the others boarding with him.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “With only ten days left until the contest, an absolutely exhausted Thorpe received some special visitors.”

rows.Speaker: Big Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “That piano sounds so wonderful♪”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “Yes, it really does!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “Huh? Squirrels...?”

rows.Speaker: Big Sister Squirrel
rows.Line:
“Hey, Mr. Pianist!
Can you play a song for us?”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “We want to learn how to dance to a song for this party we'll be attending soon.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “A pair of squirrel sisters from a nearby forest had come to visit. As cute as they were, to Thorpe, they only got in the way of him practicing.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“I don't care about your party!
I'm busy! Leave me alone!”

rows.Speaker: Big Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “Please, just one song!”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Squirrel
rows.Line: “We really want you to play it for us!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“Ugh... Fine, I'll play it!
But you need to go after it's over.”

rows.Speaker: Big Sister Squirrel
rows.Line:
“Oh wow! This is a great song!
But don't you think you're playing a bit too fast?”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Squirrel
rows.Line:
“Yeah, she's right!
We'd have to dance and twirl so fast just to keep up!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“Enough!
If all you're going to do is complain, I'm not going to play for you!”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “The squirrels danced and twirled as best they could, but before they went home, they asked Thorpe to slow things down next time.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line:
“Thorpe let out a deep sigh.
However, to his dismay, the squirrels had told their animal friends about him and they all came to visit the next day.”

rows.Speaker: Sheep
rows.Line:
“Hello, Mr. Pianist.
Can you play a nice song that'll help me and my friends from the farm fall asleep?”

rows.Speaker: Migrating Bird
rows.Line: “Mr. Pianist! I got separated from my friends! Can you play a fun song that'll let them know that I'm here?”

rows.Speaker: Big Brother Cat
rows.Line: “Mr. Pianist, my little brother and sister are sick. Can you play a song that'll make them feel better?”

rows.Speaker: Little Brother Cat
rows.Line:
“*Sob*
My tummy hurts...”

rows.Speaker: Little Sister Cat
rows.Line:
“*Sob*
My head hurts...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“Alright, fine...!
But in return, you have to leave after I'm done playing!”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “They're finally gone. I can practice in peace now...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “But there might not be any point now since the contest is tomorrow.”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
I only have half a day left...”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “The stars... They're so beautiful...”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “And so, the day of the contest had arrived.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Thorpe was worried sick about not getting to rehearse in front of others, but he desperately played as best he could. As a result...”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “That was magnificent, Thorpe!”

rows.Speaker: Bandleader
rows.Line: “How did you practice to get this good? Could it be that you found someone to listen to you play?”

rows.Speaker: Thorpe
rows.Line: “*Gasp*”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “That's right. Thorpe learned how to play in front of others because his animal friends came to listen each day.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “As the crowd called for an encore, Thorpe decided to play his favorite song to thank all the animals for what they did.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “Outside of the venue, the animals heard his performance and nodded in thanks for giving them another wonderful song... The end.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is about how it goes...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So many animals!
That sounds like a lot of fun♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, Rui!
What did you think of my performance? I personally thought there was nothing wrong!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Especially when I played the piano!
It should be smooth sailing with me at the helm!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, Tsukasa, seeing you on the piano was so cool! Especially when you went all ba-da-da-da-dum!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, despite everything that was said beforehand, you'll probably be fine with a bit of practice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No...
We shouldn't be so hasty.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree that there was nothing seriously wrong on the surface, but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're just not fit for this role, Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not fit...?
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's delve further into this question of role compatibility.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My goal is to always assign roles in a way that takes advantage of an actor's strengths.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: An actor's strengths?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Actors come in all shapes and sizes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For instance, some prefer to gradually get into character while others may try to imitate their foibles... Of course, there are prodigies who can immediately take full control of their characters, but let's set that aside for now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: From what I've seen, Tsukasa, I'd say you're someone who likes to gradually get into character. Seemingly the most popular archetype.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gradually get into character...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In simpler terms, I believe you prefer to learn by doing since you and logical analyses of characters don't usually mix well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I usually try to give you roles that are compatible with your personality, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, you've been deciding roles like this every time...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I am the director, aren't I?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought your goal was always to send Tsukasa flying, Rui♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Miku, wait.
Couldn't you have said that a little nicer?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry!
I was just trying to say how that's really cool!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyway, to continue...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist, Thorpe, is a delicate creature who tends to dwell on things quite a bit... How would you all say he compares to Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They're total opposites!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... Tsukasa usually just does whatever and isn't really bothered by much...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! I'm bothered by things just like anyone else!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But that's my point. This role involves a person with the opposite personality as you, Tsukasa. I have a feeling you'll struggle to fully get into character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You excel at using your body to perform dynamic stunts. I can't say the same about expressing a character's internal struggle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We don't have much time until our next show as ambassadors, so in terms of quality...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No...
I want to give it a try because I may struggle!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sure you all remember the show we saw when we went to Riley Dream Park...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Through my eyes, it was an absolutely incredible spectacle. The way they balanced their dynamism with subtlety kept me on the edge of my seat...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It also led me to a painful realization! It showed me that I still don't have the acting ability required to captivate an audience the way they did!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I remember how Tsukasa studied every move they made as we watched...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. Just as you suggested that we take things one step at a time, I believe I've made some progress since then.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's why I want to take on a new kind of role!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I can't just keep playing the same types of characters over and over again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's an endless number of shows out there. I'm not about to let us give up on one because I may not be able to fit into a certain role!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: By growing as an actor, our shows will evolve while also being able to try our hand at more genres.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, please! Give me a chance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the director, I believe it's my duty to put on the most fun and interesting shows possible with this troupe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: With that in mind, I cannot agree to do this show. However...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa may be right...
It's just as important to help each actor grow if we do wish to put on fun shows.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means, as a director, I probably shouldn't hinder our future star from reaching his full potential...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Does that mean we're going with this story?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, let's do this show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you, Rui!
I promise to do this role justice!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Let's do our best, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bye, Miku♪ Bye, you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Bye bye☆
Oh, Tsukasa, wait...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Yes, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good luck learning to play Thorpe!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I really loved the way you played the piano as him, so I'm sure you'll do great!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the plan...!
As a future star, I vow to put on a good performance, so just you wait!
The next day
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's start practicing “A Pianist Named Thorpe”!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is it me or does he sound louder than usual today?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He's a motivated mammoth today!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, let's begin with a read-through. Some parts are going to be tricky, so let's go slow and steady with this one.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Let's start the audition.
First up, Thorpe. Show us what you got.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thorpe tries to play but his nerves get the better of him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
“Thank you...
Alright, next.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Oh...
Based on that reaction... I failed again...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Why does this keep happening to me...? I always practice so much but can never execute when it matters most...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No... I just have to keep trying until I get used to it! I have to learn to play in front of others...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “I need to practice... Oh wow...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“The stars look so beautiful tonight.
That must be Antares...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, I'm still not getting the star scene right...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (How am I supposed to feel here...?)
Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, that's it for our read-through.
How do you all feel about this...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, me first!
I really liked how Thorpe was able to play the piano like he wanted in the end!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's not what he's asking.
He's talking about how we each feel about the way we acted.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
From what I saw...
It wasn't bad or anything, but...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After hearing what Rui said, I couldn't help but keep an eye on what Tsukasa did... He seemed different from usual...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree.
I believe we feel the same.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How did you feel, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: About that. I think I also felt what you just mentioned. Something just didn't feel quite right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How do I explain it...?
It's like I only have a superficial grasp of this character.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? Superficial? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Well, that's the thing...
I'm not sure I understand how this character truly feels...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Thorpe, how's practice going?”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, are you ad-libbing?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “If you're trying to make a living by playing at a tavern, I have to think you're having a hard time paying rent. I wish I could help you somehow...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Th-Thank you...!
Your kinds words are more than enough!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, that isn't right either...
He's supposed to be lacking in confidence. He'd probably clam up in that sort of situation...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is what he meant by a “superficial grasp”. He's having trouble reading between the lines.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, now I get it!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's been able to capture a character's essence just based on instinct until now, but as I expected, this one may prove challenging.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mind telling us more about where you're getting stuck and how, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I appreciate the help!
First, the scene when he looks up to the stars is giving me some trouble...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Thorpe lacks confidence, but also seems fairly proud of himself. Even I'm having some trouble understanding him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
